description: This file defines the CanvasController class, which manages the behavior and interactions of a WebView canvas in an Android application. It provides functions for capturing screenshots in PNG or JPEG formats, navigating URLs, toggling debug status, and maintaining canvas state.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing a WebView-based canvas, including screenshot capturing, URL navigation, debug info display, and canvas state management.

classes.name: CanvasController.SnapshotFormat
classes.description: Enum class representing image formats for canvas snapshots, either PNG or JPEG.

classes.name: CanvasController.SnapshotParams
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters for capturing snapshots, including format, quality, and maximum width.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebView to the controller and initializes relevant states.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches a WebView from the controller.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigate the WebView to the specified URL.

methods.name: currentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL loaded in the WebView.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the current canvas URL is the default scaffold.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status title and subtitle.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when a WebView page load finishes.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the canvas state JSON and applies it to the WebView.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the WebView context.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Captures a PNG screenshot of the WebView as a Base64 string, optionally scaled by maxWidth.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a screenshot in the specified format and quality, returning a Base64 string.

methods.name: parseNavigateUrl
methods.description: Parses navigation URL from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseEvalJs
methods.description: Parses JavaScript code to evaluate from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseSnapshotMaxWidth
methods.description: Parses maximum width for snapshot from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseSnapshotFormat
methods.description: Parses image format (PNG or JPEG) for snapshot from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseSnapshotQuality
methods.description: Parses quality parameter for JPEG snapshots from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParams
methods.description: Builds a SnapshotParams object from JSON parameters.
